source_summary: precisebits.com product listing tables (part number, diameter, LOC, reach, flutes, corner radius, tip/max diameter, angle, shank, OAL); the listing HTML has malformed <tr> rows, parsed by cell runs. Covers end mills for wood/plastic/metal/PCB, O-flute and micrO-flute, ball nose, tapered 3D carving, V engravers, PCB chip-breaker and diamond-cut routers, inlay/fret cutters and carbide drills. Countersinks and sets left out (no geometry columns). Precise Bits' feed tables are per tool for FR-4 PCB routing only; not stored.
